prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / style-transfer. This is a production animation SPRITE SHEET, not a character redesign.
IMAGE 1 is the authoritative ORIGINAL hero design. IMAGE 2 is the freshly upgraded sculpted-3D rendering reference for this same hero. Preserve the original identity from image 1, and match image 2's premium soft 3D materials and lighting. Keep the original head/body proportions, exact face/eye shape and colour, ears/horns, markings, clothing, equipment and palette. No extra accessories or altered anatomy.
Output exactly TWENTY complete full-body frames in a strict FIVE COLUMN by FOUR ROW regular grid. Aim for 2560 x 2048 pixels (5:4 aspect ratio), with twenty equal square cells. Correct cell count and registration are essential. No text, frame numbers, grids, borders, scenery or floor.
GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA background; outside each hero alpha must be ZERO. No visible background, no checkerboard, no glow behind the hero, no cast shadows. Each hero entirely inside its own cell with 8% empty margins. Identical camera in every cell, three-quarter facing screen right, same character scale, no camera movement or zoom, common central anchor and feet at 94% cell height. Render the same hero consistently twenty times. Carefully separate neighbouring frames, including weapons, antlers, wings and tails.

IDENTITY LOCK:
Bran is the original compact RED DRAGON HERO, not a fox. Preserve the original short cream muzzle, amber-gold eyes, two swept ivory horns, golden flame crest on forehead, red cheek spikes, cream chest fur/scales, small orange bat-membrane wings, red tail with orange flame, original brown leather chest harness and belt, dark grey metal shoulder and knee armour, brown boots, cream claws. Exactly the markings and armour from Image 1. No extra cheek spots or ear tufts. Signature action is a small controlled flame gathering near one clawed hand; no floating fireball replacing his limbs.
ANIMATION ORDER: TWENTY sequential in-between frames of ONE seamless walking-in-place cycle, in reading order across all four rows. This is a continuous 20-frame gait, NOT separate gestures or poses. Frame 0 left foot forward heel contact; frame 5 passing position; frame 10 right foot forward heel contact; frame 15 passing position; frame 19 is just before returning to frame 0. Smooth gradual leg and arm movement through every intervening frame. Natural small body rise and fall and gentle secondary motion in cloth/tail, but NO jumping or floating. Keep the hero centred, same scale, identical face and costume throughout. At least one supporting foot contacts the same 94% cell-height baseline in every frame. Tail/wings/bow stay within the cell; tail stays above foot baseline. Weapons and equipment remain attached and consistent. Twenty genuinely distinct in-between frames, no row breaks or camera changes. Do NOT perform the signature action during this walk.
